“`

And yet, Lin Yuan didn’t believe that the Insect Race would deploy Ninth Rank powers to assassinate him.

Deploying Ninth Rank combat power would be equivalent to tearing their faces off with human civilization.

If the benefits were significant enough, the Insect Race wouldn’t mind doing so, but based on the talent Lin Yuan had currently revealed, he was far from qualified.

Therefore.

Lin Yuan mainly needed to guard against invincible assassins of the Eighth Layer.

...

In the face of invincible opponents from the Eighth Layer… Lin Yuan only needed to hide inside his main star.

When Lin Yuan first arrived in the Milky Way Star Region, he swiftly and decisively cleared the largest unstable elements within the star field.

It was to reduce the frequency of his own outings later on.

“The evolvers of human civilization, upon reaching the Eighth Layer, must guard the Fringe Starfield; this is tradition, this is the rule, even the progeny of a Supreme Being is no exception.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Evolvers below the Eighth Layer are protected and supported by human civilization.

Upon reaching the Eighth Layer, they need to give back and guard the Fringe Starfield, which in fact isn’t very dangerous.

Talents like Lin Yuan who might be assassinated by Different Species are often granted numerous life-saving trump cards before heading to the Fringe Starfield.

The Soul-Settling Pearl that the Xia Qin Supreme Being gave to Lin Yuan was such an item; even if a Supreme Being from a Different Species took action, it could still preserve his chance of resurrection.

Of course, if an evolver made a tremendous contribution to human civilization, such as becoming an Evolutionary Scholar, or nearing the status of Evolutionary Scholar,

they could apply for exemption from the duty of guarding the Fringe Starfield.

But such instances are extremely rare.

With the potential that Lin Yuan had revealed, he actually qualified to apply.

But if he did, and all other newly-promoted Eighth Layer evolvers were guarding the Fringe Starfields, while Lin Yuan did not, it would be the same as announcing to the Different Species that the Galactic Star Lord had even greater secrets.

Once so, even if Lin Yuan hid in the great rear of human civilization, it wouldn’t necessarily be absolutely safe.

…

“These ten years…

Lin Yuan’s thoughts shifted, and a smile appeared on his face.

Ten years in the Main World allowed Lin Yuan to make rapid progress in all aspects.

First and foremost was his understanding of Rules, of the core models of Space Rules; Lin Yuan had already comprehended two thousand nine hundred and thirty-two types.

One must know, ten years prior, Lin Yuan’s understanding of core space models was just over two thousand types.

Over the past ten years, Lin Yuan had directly comprehended nine hundred core space models.

The difficulty of comprehending these nine hundred core space models was unknowably higher than that of the initial nine hundred.

The seven thousand seven hundred and eighty-two core space models become increasingly difficult to understand as one progresses, with the difficulty curve rising exponentially.

The difficulty of understanding the two thousandth core space model was far greater than that of the first.

This was reflected in the expansion of his Inner World; the later space models, once comprehended, contributed more significantly to the expansion of his Inner World.

And the two thousand nine hundred and thirty-two core space models directly expanded Lin Yuan’s Inner World to a radius of two million miles.

This radius of two million miles refers to the normal size of an Inner World.

After the basic amplification by the crimson liquid, Lin Yuan’s Inner World reached a radius of six million six hundred and sixty-six miles.

With the basic amplification by the orange-yellow liquid, Lin Yuan’s Inner World now exceeded ten million miles in radius.

“The orange-yellow liquid…”

Lin Yuan took out the Mysterious Gourd, which by now was a grey-yellow color and faintly emitted a mysterious aura.

Whether it be the initial crimson liquid or the orange-yellow liquid, both provided a basic amplification to the body and the Inner World.

Compared to the crimson liquid, Lin Yuan absorbed the orange-yellow liquid much more slowly; in ten years, he had only absorbed a little more than half.

“Now, the basic amplification of my physical body and Inner World has probably reached about five times?”

Lin Yuan estimated in his heart.

Three-point-three-three times from the crimson liquid, nearly twice from the orange-yellow liquid.

The latter is less than the former because Lin Yuan hasn’t fully absorbed the orange-yellow liquid.

In theory, if Lin Yuan were to absorb the orange-yellow liquid completely, the final amplification could reach six-point-six-six times.

“It’s terrifying…”

Even after more than a decade, Lin Yuan was still amazed by the effects of the Mysterious Gourd.

It provided a basic amplification, not a mere addition or subtraction; now Lin Yuan’s Inner World had reached ten million miles.

An Inner World of ten million miles.

That’s the limit for human Evolvers, achievable only at the Eighth Layer after fully comprehending Complete Space Rules.

But fully comprehending Complete Space Rules at the Eighth Layer was practically impossible, with some Ninth Rank powerhouses not having achieved it either.

Yet Lin Yuan, in a way, had done it.

Although he had not comprehended Complete Space Rules, he nevertheless had one of the greatest benefits of doing so.

An Inner World with a radius of ten million miles.

And the Inner World with a radius of ten million miles was not Lin Yuan’s limit; he could continue to increase it, by a substantial margin.

“With an Inner World of ten million miles in radius, my current combat power, even if it’s not quite on par with an invincible Eighth Layer, isn’t far off either.”

“`

Lin Yuan scrutinized himself.

According to his speculation, if his Inner World reached tens of millions of miles in circumference, even without comprehending some form of Cosmic Force, he could still forcefully contend with an Eighth Layer invincible.

If his Inner World reached hundreds of millions of miles, then he would be able to crush an Eighth Layer invincible.

From time immemorial, the myth that Eighth Layer invincibles stood unbeatable at their level had belonged to them alone.

Yet, as long as Lin Yuan continued to cultivate, he could break this myth.

“It’s a pity that the Taiyin Rule is still lacking a bit.”

Lin Yuan sighed. In the past decade, much of his effort had been placed on absorbing the orange-yellow liquid and understanding Space Rules among other things.

This caused a delay in fully comprehending the Taiyin Rule.

Even so, Lin Yuan felt that he was close; even if he did nothing at all, in at most two to three years, the Taiyin Rule would naturally be comprehended.

This is the essence of the complementary nature of Yin and Yang within the Dao of Taiji.

When one side improves, the other side’s improvement is a natural consequence.

…

“World-Breaking Origin Force… already thirty-six strands…”

Lin Yuan’s mind sank into the depths of his mind, looking towards that majestic and grand Door to the Myriad Realms.

Ten years ago, the amount of World-Breaking Origin Force Lin Yuan had accumulated was only seventeen strands, but now it had risen to thirty-six strands.

“At the moment, the Milky Way Star Region’s development is stable, and there’s no need for me to do anything, so I can undertake the eighth traversal.”

Lin Yuan thought.

However, for the eighth traversal, Lin Yuan was still somewhat hesitant on how to choose.

“Hmm?”

Lin Yuan’s gaze shifted, looking towards a certain direction of the main star.

There was a mountain peak where Ruan Wei, the Eighth Rank Evolver who had actively come to follow Lin Yuan more than a decade ago, resided.

At this moment, Ruan Wei stood on the mountain peak, with the space around her faintly distorting—a sign that she was trying to comprehend the core Space Model.

“Wrong.”

“The direction is wrong.”

Lin Yuan immediately spotted the issue with Ruan Wei’s approach.

The Space Rules are vast and boundless, and the 7,782 core Space Models summed up by the predecessors of Human Civilization only explain some aspects of the essence of Space Rules.

Each person who comprehends the core Space Models may derive different insights.

“Well then.”

Lin Yuan decided and vanished from the palace.

“Space? What exactly is space?”

Ruan Wei’s eyebrows were tightly furrowed, and her aura began to destabilize subtly.

At that moment.

Lin Yuan appeared.

He pointed a finger at Ruan Wei’s brow.

In an instant, the space fluctuations around them slowly dissipated, and the unstable aura within Ruan Wei gradually stabilized.

“Star Lord.”

Ruan Wei came to her senses and immediately saluted Lin Yuan with gratitude.

“Space is everything.”

Lin Yuan shook his head and spoke.

As someone who had already comprehended nearly three thousand core Space Models, Lin Yuan was fully qualified to correct Ruan Wei’s deviation.

“Space is everything?”

Ruan Wei looked slightly bewildered.

“Space encompasses all, what you see as space is only an insignificant part. The Cosmic Starry Sky, layer upon layer of space, is almost endless.”

“When you comprehend Space Rules, never try to concretize space; otherwise, it’s easy to go astray,” Lin Yuan cautioned.

For Evolvers trying to comprehend Space Rules, it’s like a blind man feeling an elephant: no concrete standards exist, but assuming that space is like the elephant’s leg just because one felt it, would be a huge mistake.

“Thank you, Star Lord.”

Ruan Wei felt inspired and bowed excitedly.

She had been trying hard to sense the Space Rules, attempting to imagine what they looked like, not realizing she had been venturing into forbidden territory.

Once she truly fixed a specific image of space in her mind, going forward, it would be very difficult for her to make further progress in the Space Rules.

Although Lin Yuan had only casually reminded her, without a doubt, he had steered Ruan Wei back onto the broadest path of the Great Dao.

This was one reason why many Evolvers were willing to follow a strong leader; often, just one piece of guidance from a strong being could pull them out of a dead-end.

One sentence might change a lifetime.
